格蕾丝的生活方式(Grace's Way of Living): 一篇关于校园生活的B1记叙文:格蕾丝的经历、感受与成长。

Grace ordered soup and juice at the school library last night. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, his student loan repayments start next April.
Little by little, things began to change. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Peer tutoring raised the class average.

Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Grace keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. His behaviour at school has improved.

Tom and Grace are preparing a report about the playground. Grace thanked Tom for the honest advice. On Sunday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. He sublet his room while on the year abroad.
The school library has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
